reviews.author: bhargavi govindarajan
reviews.text:
Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy or Aishu as I fondly call her is one of the impeccable gynaecologists out there. Having trained in some of India's most prestigious institutions, her academic and hands-on achievements are unparalleled. But what really sets her apart is her calm and compassionate approach, patience and diligence. She's very dedicated in her practice and made me feel very comfortable during the consultation. She makes sure that all her patients feel confident and very clearly explains the next steps.

Coming from the US where it takes months to get a specialist appointment and even then the doctor would just rush through the consultation and most of them wouldn't give a damn about making the patient calm and comfortable, I was pleasently surprised at how much time and effort she put in answering all my questions. She has also put together a great team at ASCAS!

Dr. Aishwarya being a top fertility expert in Chennai is certainly going to scale to even greater heights globally! I highly recommend her if you're looking for a top notch gynec who's not just extremely knowledgeable but actually cares about her patients, not money driven and makes sure she and her team are always there for you!

reviews.author: Bharath Marimuthu
reviews.text:
We can't thank Dr. Aishwarya enough for the amazing care and support throughout my wife's pregnancy and delivery. This was our second pregnancy after a 5-year gap, and from our very first visit, she made us feel comfortable, informed, and reassured. Her expertise, patience, and kindness made the whole journey so much smoother and stress-free.

The clinic has everything you need for a hassle-free pregnancy experience—scans, blood tests, a pharmacy, and CTG monitoring for the last trimester. A special shoutout to Dr. Ashwin, who was incredibly kind and supportive during our scans.

During delivery, Dr. Aishwarya and her team made sure everything went smoothly. Even after the birth, she continued to provide excellent care and guiding us through recovery.

A big thank you for everything! 😊

reviews.author: Anitha R
reviews.text:

My heartfelt thanks to Dr.Aishwarya, whose expertise, guidance, and constant encouragement kept me strong throughout this emotional journey. She was more than a doctor to me – she was a source of hope and reassurance in every step we took.

A special thank you to the wonderful sisters Anu,Uma,Sharmi,Ashwini,and Madhu – your warmth, patience, and genuine care made me feel supported, heard, and never alone. Whether it was a small query or a nervous moment, you were always there with a smile and a comforting word.

This success is not just mine – it belongs to all of you who stood by me with love and dedication. Thank you for making our dream come true.

reviews.author: Vigneshwari Parthiban
reviews.text: I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy for the exceptional care and support throughout my pregnancy and delivery. From the very beginning, the doctor provided confidence, reassurance, and expert guidance, making the entire journey smooth and stress-free. Their patience in answering all my concerns, timely advice, and availability at every stage gave me immense comfort. The delivery experience was handled with utmost care, and I truly appreciate whole team dedication, support and professionalism. I highly recommend Dr. Aishwarya to anyone looking for a compassionate and skilled gynecologist!

reviews.author: Limitless Enterprises
reviews.text: My mother was experiencing severe abdominal pain, and we consulted Dr. Aishwarya. Her diagnosis and guidance were exceptional, and thanks to her timely intervention, my mother was out of danger. Dr. Aishwarya was incredibly supportive, taking the time to explain every procedure clearly. She showed great care and compassion throughout, which gave us immense confidence and comfort. I sincerely thank Dr. Aishwarya from the bottom of my heart for her dedication and expertise.

reviews.author: Dr. Rubina Singh
reviews.text:
A Team That Embodies Excellence, Expertise & Compassion = Team Accumed – Dr. Aishwarya & Dr. Ashwin

There are doctors, and then there are those rare few who leave you with an everlasting impact—not just with their expertise but with the sheer warmth, confidence, and dedication they bring to their practice. Dr. Aishwarya is one such remarkable doctor. From the moment I met her, I was struck by her subtle yet strong confidence—a quiet yet powerful assurance that made me feel instantly safe and cared for. She carries an air of effortless expertise, strong ethics while exuding calmness in every interaction, no matter how big or small the concern.

What truly sets her apart is the Midas touch she has—not just in her strong skill set but in the way she connects with her patients. She listens patiently, answers every doubt with clarity, and never rushes through an appointment. Her ability to make even the most anxious moments feel manageable is a gift, and I feel incredibly fortunate to have been under her care.

Complementing her, Beside her is equally skilled and compassionate, Dr. Ashwin, whose precision in prenatal scans adds another layer of reassurance. His ability to explain every detail thoroughly, ensuring that every scan is both informative and comforting, made all the difference in my journey. His expertise, combined with his patient and kind demeanor, transforms what could be a nervous experience into one filled with confidence and positivity.

No exceptional clinic is complete without an outstanding support system, and Dr. Aishwarya and Dr. Ashwin’s team—Ashwini, Anu, Uma, Sharmi, Madhu and Deepti —are truly the pillars of support of this clinic. Their kindness, attentiveness, cheerfulness and unwavering dedication creates an atmosphere that is not just professional but deeply welcoming and reassuring. Walking into their clinic always felt like stepping into a place of comfort, where every member of the team goes the extra mile to ensure you feel valued and cared for.

If you are looking for a doctor who is not only highly skilled and knowledgeable, but also compassionate, confident, and deeply invested in your well-being, Dr. Aishwarya is the one. Alongside Dr. Ashwin and their exceptional team at Accumed, they create a gold standard of care that is truly unmatched.

As I hold my baby in my arms, I am beyond grateful for their support to me so far and ahead as well. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking the very best!

reviews.author: Mohamed Akthar
reviews.text:
We are truly blessed  to have been under the care of Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy for my wife’s pregnancy and safe delivery. From the very beginning, Dr. Aishwarya was nothing short of amazing — a gem of a person, always with a positive attitude, extremely friendly, and someone who genuinely puts her heart into caring for her patients. She made every step of our journey smooth, reassuring, and filled with confidence.

During labor and delivery, her presence brought immense comfort to both of us. She ensured my wife felt calm, supported, and well cared for. Her dedication and compassion left a lasting impression on us that we will cherish forever.

A special thanks to Dr. Ashwin,  an excellent radiologist, who conducted all of my wife’s scans with great detail, patience, and care. His calm approach and thorough explanations gave us so much clarity and peace of mind throughout the pregnancy.

We also want to sincerely thank the amazing nurses Anu, Sharmi, and Ashwini for their exceptional care during every hospital visit. Their kindness, professionalism, and gentle support meant the world to us.

This entire team gave us not just medical care, but emotional strength and warmth during one of the most important times in our lives. From the bottom of our hearts — thank you all for helping us welcome our baby into the world with so much love and care

reviews.author: Huda Huzuz
reviews.text:
I genuinely don’t have enough words to thank Dr. Aishwarya for the incredible care and support she gave me throughout my motherhood journey. From the very beginning when we were just planning to conceive she was there, guiding us through each step with such warmth, knowledge, and compassion.

What sets her apart is not just her medical expertise, but the way she treats her patients with patience, kindness, and a sense of personal connection. No question was ever too small, no concern ever dismissed. Every time I felt anxious or unsure, she would calmly explain things, helping me understand and feel confident. She was always available, even during unexpected moments, ready to guide or reassure us whenever we needed her.

Every milestone right from conception to the final day in the hospital felt safe and special because of her. She provided valuable suggestions at every important turn and made sure we were never left confused or overwhelmed.

I also want to extend a heartfelt thanks to the staff and nurses at the clinic. They were always polite and efficient, making the entire process smooth and hassle free. It really allowed me to focus on my health and well-being without having to stress about appointments or formalities.

Dr. Aishwarya isn’t just a doctor she became a part of our journey, someone I’ll never forget. I feel truly blessed to have had her as my gynecologist, and I would wholeheartedly and passionately recommend her to every expecting mother. Thank you, doctor, for everything. ❤️
